newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin price ends two cents down to 14.65 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin price ends two cents down to 14.65 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell two cents to 14.65 ringgit ($5.83) a kg after marginally following a huge overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange.
"There was some buying which eased the offerings, otherwise the price would have come down further," said a Malaysian trader. The LME closed $75 lower on Tuesday.

Dealers said offers totalled 95 tonnes against bids of 69. Final turnover was at 64 tonnes, down from 106 on Tuesday. Buyers were from Europe and Malaysia. There was a local premium of $55 a tonne over London after being at par on Tuesday.
